overview: The railway made worth building: faster track that switches itself, a handbrake for the rider, carts chained into trains, and working carts that lay track and dig.

1.1.3: A chain of TNT carts goes off as one charge and bores a corridor you can walk down, with an advancement for the first real tunnel.
Rail laid ahead spans drops and follows a climb instead of stopping, chained carts hold one speed along the link, and a cart with a heading wears an arrow that says which way it is pointed.
1.0.0: Speed lives in the track, rails switch themselves, the rider gets a handbrake, carts couple into trains, and three of the working carts become tools that lay track or dig.
